LanguageData.SY_CA.TooltipFenceBlocked: Set animal to be able to pass or not pass fences, disregarding roaming setting Checked - disallow passing fences Unchecked - allow passing fences Undetermined - uses roaming setting to determine ability to pass fences (set via Reset)
LanguageData.SY_CA.TooltipFenceBlockedAlways: Block all animals from passing fences, can be overridden by "Not when following"
LanguageData.SY_CA.TooltipFenceBlockedNotWhenFollowin: Allow animals following their master to ignore fences
